# 配置由它怎样关系而定：互模拟所联系的配置相同，相同的配置通过同样的检验；有意义的描述恰把相同者等同，并承载规律；作为相等的确定性依赖于命名 / A configuration is how it relates: configurations related by a bisimulation are alike and pass the same tests; a description makes sense where it identifies exactly the alike ones, and then carries a law; determinacy as equality depends on names

## 主张 Claim

设 F 与 G 是配置类型 S 与 S′ 上、动作类型 A 与主张类型 C 相同的框架。关系 B 是它们之间的互模拟（Bisimulation F G B），指被联系的配置实现同样的主张，任一方的每一步都由另一方以同一动作到被联系配置的一步相配；s 与 s′ 相同（Alike F G s s′），指有互模拟联系它们。相等是互模拟，互模拟的逆是互模拟，两个互模拟可以复合（Bisimulation.eq、Bisimulation.converse、Bisimulation.comp）；所以相同是自反、对称、传递的（Alike.refl、Alike.symm、Alike.trans），作为关系陈述，因为商需要 Quot.sound。相同的配置实现同样的主张（Alike.realized），以同一动作到相同配置的一步彼此相配（Alike.step），每个动作序列都到相同的配置（Bisimulation.trace、Alike.trace），通过同样的检验：一个动作序列之后的一个主张（Alike.tests）。框架在 s 处相同之下确定（DeterminedAt F s），指 s 处同一动作的任何两个结果相同；确定的框架处处如此（Determined.at）；相同之下的确定性沿相同传递（DeterminedAt.transfer），它成立时同一动作把相同的配置带到相同的配置（DeterminedAt.goAlike）。Twins 中起点以一个动作有两个后继：它们相同（Twins.left_alike_right），框架不确定（Twins.not_determined），而它的起点与只有一个后继的框架的起点相同，后者确定，所以双胞胎在起点处相同之下确定（Twins.alike_one）。交换之律经“某个关系项立于某量”这些主张读（exchangeFrame），在每个关系项上相等是互模拟（exchange_pointwise_bisimulation）；水平相同，恰当它们在每个关系项上相等（exchange_alike_iff、exchange_alike_of_pointwise、exchange_pointwise_of_alike）；这条律在每个水平处相同之下确定（exchange_determinedAt）。配置的一个描述 π 有意义（MakesSense F π），指它恰把相同的配置等同；它有意义，恰当被它等同这一关系是互模拟且它等同每一对相同者（makesSense_iff）；有意义的描述等同同样的配置（MakesSense.unique）；框架处处相同之下确定时，有意义的描述承载规律（MakesSense.carries，经 Becoming.Mechanism 的 carries_law_iff）；以配置自身命名有意义，恰当相同的配置是同一个（makesSense_id_iff），双胞胎的命名没有意义（Twins.naming_senseless）。对确定的律经一个识读（Law.registered next o，主张是所识者），配置相同，恰当它们所识的未来相同（Law.SameFuture、Law.alike_iff_sameFuture；Law.alike_future、Law.sameFuture_bisimulation），这时有意义的描述承载规律（Law.MakesSense.carries）。外围桥接（Becoming.Bridge）中：RelationalDynamics 的 Deeper.Bisimulation 就是核心的没有主张的框架之间的互模拟（Frame.unclaimed、deeper_bisimulation_iff），所以 static 与 toggle 中一方的每个配置都与另一方的每个配置相同（static_toggle_alike）；ExplanatoryBranching.Bisimulation 就是以模型的条件为主张的框架之间的互模拟（Frame.ofModel、branching_bisimulation_iff），相同的配置通过每个分支检验，否定与合取在内（Alike.same，经 bisimulation_implies_same）。不用 Lean 公理。 / Let F and G be frames on configurations S and S′ with the same moves A and claims C. A relation B is a bisimulation between them (Bisimulation F G B) where related configurations realize the same claims and each step of either is matched by a step of the other by the same move into related configurations; s and s′ are alike (Alike F G s s′) where some bisimulation relates them. Equality is a bisimulation, the converse of a bisimulation is one, and two compose (Bisimulation.eq, Bisimulation.converse, Bisimulation.comp); so likeness is reflexive, symmetric and transitive (Alike.refl, Alike.symm, Alike.trans), stated as a relation since a quotient needs Quot.sound. Alike configurations realize the same claims (Alike.realized), match each other's steps by the same move into alike configurations (Alike.step) and every course of moves into alike configurations (Bisimulation.trace, Alike.trace), and pass the same tests, a course of moves followed by a claim (Alike.tests). A frame is determined up to likeness at s (DeterminedAt F s) where any two outcomes of one move at s are alike; a determined frame is so everywhere (Determined.at); determinacy up to likeness passes along likeness (DeterminedAt.transfer), and where it holds the same move takes alike configurations to alike ones (DeterminedAt.goAlike). In Twins a start has two successors by one move: they are alike (Twins.left_alike_right), the frame is not determined (Twins.not_determined), and its start is alike to the start of a frame with one successor, which is determined, so the twins are determined up to likeness at the start (Twins.alike_one). Under the law of exchange read through the claims that a relatum stands at an amount (exchangeFrame), agreeing at every relatum is a bisimulation (exchange_pointwise_bisimulation); standings are alike exactly where they agree at every relatum (exchange_alike_iff, exchange_alike_of_pointwise, exchange_pointwise_of_alike), and the law is determined up to likeness at every standing (exchange_determinedAt). A description π of configurations makes sense (MakesSense F π) where it identifies exactly the alike configurations; it does exactly where being identified by it is a bisimulation and it identifies every alike pair (makesSense_iff); descriptions that make sense identify the same configurations (MakesSense.unique); where the frame is determined up to likeness everywhere, a description that makes sense carries a law (MakesSense.carries, through carries_law_iff of Becoming.Mechanism); naming the configurations makes sense exactly where alike configurations are one (makesSense_id_iff), and the twins' naming does not (Twins.naming_senseless). For a determined law read through a registration (Law.registered next o, the claims being what is registered), configurations are alike exactly where their registered futures are the same (Law.SameFuture, Law.alike_iff_sameFuture; Law.alike_future, Law.sameFuture_bisimulation), and there a description that makes sense carries a law (Law.MakesSense.carries). In the periphery bridge (Becoming.Bridge): Deeper.Bisimulation of RelationalDynamics is the core's bisimulation of frames with no claims (Frame.unclaimed, deeper_bisimulation_iff), so in static and toggle every configuration of one is alike to every configuration of the other (static_toggle_alike); ExplanatoryBranching.Bisimulation is the core's bisimulation of frames whose claims are a model's conditions (Frame.ofModel, branching_bisimulation_iff), and alike configurations pass every branching test, negation and conjunction included (Alike.same, through bisimulation_implies_same). No Lean axiom is used.

Canonical source: [Unfolding.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Unfolding.lean)

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 不加前提：相同由互模拟刻画，不是假设，也不取商；Alike.tests、exchange_alike_iff、makesSense_iff 与 makesSense_id_iff 是双向的。 / No premise: likeness is characterized by bisimulation, not assumed, and no quotient is taken; Alike.tests, exchange_alike_iff, makesSense_iff and makesSense_id_iff are two-way.
- 互模拟比较动作与主张类型相同的框架；检验是一个有限动作序列之后的一个主张，经同样检验推出相同（需要分支条件）没有陈述。 / Bisimulation compares frames with the same move and claim types; a test is a claim after a finite course of moves, and that passing the same tests makes configurations alike (which needs a condition on branching) is not stated.
- 相同之下的确定性（DeterminedAt）是定义；第一部分以 Determined 陈述的定理没有以它重述。 / Determinacy up to likeness (DeterminedAt) is a definition; the Part I theorems stated with Determined are not restated with it.
- MakesSense.carries 要框架在每个配置处相同之下确定；有意义的描述是给出的，不推出它存在。 / MakesSense.carries needs the frame determined up to likeness at every configuration; a description that makes sense is supplied, and that one exists is not derived.
- 见证的结论：Twins 的框架，以及经 exchangeFrame 读的交换之律。 / For the witnesses: the frames of Twins, and the law of exchange read through exchangeFrame.

P69 的第四项（工作板），按 Ren 2026-10-12 的“yes, put it on the board and start”：从 World 一侧陈述“配置先于其间的关系”这一分割。它把外围的关系的同一（RelationalDynamics，2026-10-06；ExplanatoryBranching 的分支检验）带进核心。那里发现“状态不变”读的是载体的相等（unchanged_reads_carrier_identity）；作为相等的确定性也如此（Twins）。读法（AI 的，待 Ren）：配置的名字，像关系项的名字（Becoming.Identity）一样，不承载任何东西，能查明的对相同的配置都一样；交换之律下水平在每个关系项上相等就是相同，所以零前提计划以逐点性质代替函数外延性的承诺（§1.2，b(5)）陈述的是水平的关系的同一，函数外延性只会再加上相同的水平是同一个。有意义的描述在本模块的定义上，对有分支、带主张的框架重述分支“Current math core (fork)”对一个确定的律检查过的 MakesSense（其 Saying.lean，回答 Ren 关于框架与成对的问题）。见整合文档 §91。 / The fourth item of P69 (work board), following Ren's “yes, put it on the board and start” of 12 October 2026: the split “configurations prior to their relation” stated from the world's side. It brings into the core the periphery's relational identity of configurations (RelationalDynamics, 6 October 2026; the branching tests of ExplanatoryBranching). There a step leaving the configuration unchanged was found to read the carrier's equality (unchanged_reads_carrier_identity); so does determinacy as equality (Twins). Readings (the AI's, pending Ren): the names of configurations, like those of relata (Becoming.Identity), carry nothing, and what can be found out is the same for alike configurations; under the law of exchange, agreeing at every relatum is being alike, so the zero-premise plan's commitment to pointwise properties in place of function extensionality (§1.2, b(5)) states the relational identity of standings, function extensionality adding only that alike standings are one and the same. Descriptions that make sense restate on this module's definitions, for frames that branch and carry claims, the MakesSense checked for one determined law on the branch "Current math core (fork)" (its Saying.lean, answering Ren's questions on framing and pairs). See §91 of the integration note.
